name: Campingplatz Litzelau
beschreibung: The Campingplatz Litzelau is located in Tirol, Österreich, in a quiet location on the edge of the valley. The atmosphere is rural and relaxing, surrounded by alpine nature. The surroundings offer hiking trails and, in winter, access to several ski areas. The amenities include sanitary facilities, electricity connections, and a small kiosk. Guests can expect a close-to-nature stay with simple infrastructure here. The site is open year-round and offers pitches for tents, caravans, and motorhomes.
